title: Compressed Air - Pressure Drop Diagrams, Metric Units
description: Pressure loss in compressed air pipe lines. Pressure drop can be estimated for typical entering pressures. The diagrams are calculated for schedule 40 pipes.

components.content:
## Compressed Air Pipeline Pressure Drop Calculator

Pressure loss in compressed air pipe lines measured in **kg/m² per 100 m** of pipe for various entering pressures.

The diagrams below are calculated for [schedule 40 pipes](https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/ansi-steel-pipes-d_305.html).

### Unit Conversions
- _1 kg/cm² = 0.98 bar = 735 mmHg = 10000 mmH₂O = 14.2 psi_
- _1 m³/min = 0.017 m³/s = 60 m³/h = 1000 liter/min = 35.3 cfm_
- _1 m (meter) = 3.2808 ft = 39.37 in_

### Schedule 40 Pipe Pressure Drop Reference Tables

## Pressure Drop Calculation for Non-Schedule 40 Pipes

For pipes other than schedule 40, use the following formula:

**dp = dp₄₀ × (d₄₀ / d)⁵**

Where:
- **dp** = actual pressure drop (kg/m² per 100 m pipe)
- **dp₄₀** = pressure drop in schedule 40 pipe from table above (kg/m² per 100 m pipe)
- **d₄₀** = inside diameter schedule 40 pipe (mm)
- **d** = actual inside diameter (mm)
